hint: Processing media with video / audio in scripts needs AutoJs6 {{ required_host_version_name }} (internal build {{ required_host_version_code }}) or later; the plugin screens, the timeline editor and the Studio recorder do not depend on AutoJs6
See the [video](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/video) and [audio](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/audio) chapters of the AutoJs6 documentation for the script API
feature: Video processing: trim, join, speed (0.25x - 8x), scale, rotate, crop and flip, text or image watermarks, audio track extraction or removal, and transcoding (H.264, or H.265 where the device supports it)
Frames, thumbnails and GIF: PNG / JPG files or Image objects, and a built-in GIF encoder (palette, dithering, looping)
Audio processing: trim, join, mix (scaled down automatically when it would clip), volume and fades, speed, and conversion to M4A / WAV / FLAC / OGG (OGG needs Android 10+)
Multi-track composition with video.compose: up to 8 video tracks and 16 audio tracks, 7 transitions, text / image overlays and subtitles
Subtitles: SRT reading and writing and a basic subset of ASS, burned into the picture with video.burnSubtitles, and video.subtitles.parse / write for subtitle files

AutoJs6 script modules video / audio (AutoJs6 {{ required_host_version_name }}, Rhino, Node.js and Bun): every processing method has an xxxAsync form and a progress callback, and stopping the script cancels its tasks

Studio screens: media library, toolbox, task queue and settings; the appearance follows AutoJs6 or uses its own language, night mode and theme color, and the settings guide you to all files access and unrestricted battery use
Toolbox wizards: one wizard per processing feature, with forms that show defaults and ranges, and a result page with the output, the media information and the equivalent script
Timeline editor: multi-track editing, transitions, overlay and subtitle editing, live preview, undo / redo, projects saved as .slate.json, and export into the task queue
Code generation: the wizards, the timeline and the recorder show the equivalent complete script, ready to copy or to open in AutoJs6 as a new script
Studio recorder: microphone, device audio (Android 10+) or both, M4A / WAV, pause / resume, recording with the screen off and controls in the notification
Long tasks run in a foreground service with a progress notification; the settings choose the hardware encoder preference and how many tasks run at once (1 - 2)
Outputs without a path go to the 3-Slate Studio folders under Movies, Music and Pictures and are registered in the media library
Update check: reads the official plugin index at most once every 12 hours when the home screen opens, and a release can be ignored
A single APK for every ABI: the only native library comes from Jetpack Compose and is aligned to 16 KB memory pages
Screens, README, Plugin Center instructions and changelog in 10 languages
dependency: Attach Jetpack Media3 1.10.1 (Transformer, Effect, Muxer, ExoPlayer and UI, for processing and previews)
Attach Jetpack Compose BOM 2026.09.00 (the plugin screens)
Attach Material Color Utilities (MaterialKolor) 4.1.1 (theme color of the plugin screens)
